## 1. Overview

This document links the Android implementation of `{module}` to the product documentation it realizes. It is a reference map, not a design document and not a coding guide.

## 2. Scope

This module implements:

- The processes whose **Target** is *Android* in section 3 of the referenced FEATURE-MOBILE documents
- The screens, widgets, and navigation destinations assigned to Android in the Epic DESIGN

Out of scope:

- Business logic — it lives in `constructor-sdk/feature/{miniapp}/`, see `IMPL-KMP`
- iOS UI — see `IMPL-IOS`
- Design-system component definitions — see the platform design system
